title: Queen of Shadows
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: The fourth Throne of Glass book. A hunted heroine returns to the capital of the empire that destroyed her family, intending to take it back, while old friends and enemies close in.
readIf: you want a big return-and-revenge fantasy once the series has been established.
skipIf: you want a light story or are bothered by mentions of sexual violence and cruelty.

pairings.reason: The classic revenge saga in which a wronged person returns in disguise to settle old scores.
Another young-adult fantasy ensemble that mixes sharp action with emotional cost.
If you liked the violence and want an adult, cynical alternative.
